question: Should Workspaces permanently expose the new `bus:pubsub` capability and widget message protocol to approved agent-authored widgets?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but it expands the durable manifest and untrusted iframe bridge contract beyond the merged Workspaces foundation; automation cannot choose that product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded bus
options.body: Accept the parent-owned, in-memory, same-tab capability after current-head real browser proof confirms its isolation and lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Defer pub/sub
options.body: Keep the widget bridge read/prompt-only and pause or close this PR until inter-widget coordination is explicitly prioritized.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request an experimental or built-in-only coordination seam before exposing a manifest capability to custom widgets.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded bus
recommendation.body: Accept the parent-owned, in-memory, same-tab capability after current-head real browser proof confirms its isolation and lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Workspaces foundation and its custom-widget security boundary were integrated under this owner's current-main work.
